title: UW Implementation Manifest
description: Self-declaration that any conforming UW Markdown implementation SHOULD expose so consumers can discover what tier, verification profiles, capabilities, and asset classes it supports. Mirrors the ImplementationManifest interface in @uwmd/core/protocol.ts. See UW_PROTOCOL_v1.md §I.4 and Part II (Protocol 3.0 conformance model, RFC 0078).

format_version.description: Format semver this implementation can read (e.g. '1.1').

anyOf.description: Protocol 2.x tier, deprecated by RFC 0078 and accepted during Protocol 3.x. Read through the mapping in UW_PROTOCOL §II.5.

tier.description: Conformance tier the implementation self-certifies to (UW_PROTOCOL Part II, RFC 0078): 'reader' (parse and check that a document is well formed) or 'verifier' (reader, plus the Format validation rules, metric reproduction, the stated-figure verifiers and receipt verification). OPTIONAL per §II.5: an implementation whose capabilities do not stack into a tier SHOULD publish `capabilities` and omit this field rather than round down (or up). The four Protocol 2.x values stay accepted during Protocol 3.x, are deprecated, and are read as: tier-1-reader -> reader; tier-2-editor -> reader, plus a non-normative starter-product editing claim; tier-3-calc-host -> verifier; tier-4-agent-host -> verifier, plus a non-normative starter-product agent-host claim. The mapping infers no profiles; declare them in `profiles`.

profiles.description: Optional verification profiles the implementation claims (UW_PROTOCOL §II.3, RFC 0078). module: evaluate module-declared and document-declared formulas. integrity: hash chains and block signatures. representations: UW Lite, XML mapping and CSV bundle. portfolio: portfolio and relationship sidecars. sensitivity: reproduce stated sensitivity grids. stochastic: reproduce stated seeded distributions. A profile adds to either tier. Absent means none.

capabilities.description: Finer-grained capability flags. Tier and profiles carry the conformance claim; capabilities advertise partial conformance, and the starter-product claims (edit-*, render-*, agent-host, refinement, capability-verify) that are outside the Protocol's tiers (UW_PROTOCOL §II.4).

supported_locales.description: Display locales this implementation renders (RFC 0001). Absent means ['en-US']. A display render of a file whose declared locale is outside this list is refused with LOC-01, never silently rendered in a different locale. Locale governs display only - content is canonical and locale-free.

asset_classes.description: Asset classes the implementation specifically supports. Omit to mean 'all'.

role.description: Form factor of the implementation. Informational.
